cells.gaps: MLI-016 reads the 2013 law as enacted with no commencement date; later rows (MLI-002, MLI-020, MLI-025) show it applied, so in-force stands. MLI-005 is a secondary summary of the 2025 annual report, not the report itself.
cells.note: Law 2013-015 is in force, Decree 2024-0300 (fees under the law) is in force, and MLI-005 counts fines and complaints handled for January-December 2025, inside 24 months of the as-at, with a constituted APDP. I read MLI-012 (formal notices) as activity, not a count of settled decisions, though the row carries reported; it does not change the stage.
